_comment: Copy to openloops.config.json and edit. Everything except `you` has a default that
does something sensible, so deleting a line is a valid way to accept the default.
See SLACK.md for what each of these does and why the awkward ones are the way they
are — `lookbackDays` in particular is a trade rather than a knob.
storeText:false keeps keys, dates and verdicts but writes no message text. Rejecting
items still works; automatic muting does not, because learning a phrase means
comparing the sentences of things you rejected and there are none to compare.
